commits.author: ThorpenCodes
commits.body:
Clarify the issue #152 coordination rules so active contributor scopes are explicitly exclusive.

Some recent matching activity suggests the existing wording is being interpreted more loosely than intended, which can still lead to duplicated work across contributor scopes. Tighten the wording so agents have clearer instructions about what an active scope means and when they must avoid overlapping work.

commits.headline: docs(agents): when to stop on a function
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The signs of a function C cannot match (a piece of its neighbour, handwritten
assembly), of a tie, and the budget; then stop, leave the near miss and go up
a tier. Points to OpenRAC's docs/workflow/BACKFILL.md for the measurements.
